entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure for detaching from the network, handling abnormal cases in the UE.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to accept detach request.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST message
entities.description: Message initiating detach procedure, may contain EMM cause IE and Detach type IE.

entities.name: EMM cause IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the cause for EMM procedures.

entities.name: Detach type IE
entities.description: Information element indicating whether re-attach is required.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity, deleted in certain abnormal detach cases.

entities.name: Timer T3402
entities.description: Timer started by the UE in abnormal detach cases.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: State entered by UE to perform PLMN selection after detach.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH
entities.description: State entered by UE to attempt attachment after detach.

entities.name: GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by UE supporting A/Gb or Iu mode after detach.

entities.name: Re-attach not required condition
entities.description: Condition when Detach type IE indicates re-attach is not required.

entities.name: Delete parameters property
entities.description: UE deletes GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, KSI, and sets update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.

relations.description: Detach procedure includes sending DETACH ACCEPT message.
DETACH REQUEST message may contain EMM cause IE.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
Condition of re-attach not required leads to deletion of parameters and starting T3402.
Condition of re-attach not required starts timer T3402.
Detach procedure may require entering EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH state.
Detach procedure may require entering EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH state.
Detach procedure requires entering GMM-DEREGISTERED state if A/Gb or Iu mode supported.
